text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: 10 paint cans—transport, complete.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
W-Whew, you saved me~!
Well, thanks a bunch~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(The Holy Hoof Festival—I hear our class's booth
is a candied apple stall, but...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (...Is simple assistance all I can offer again this year, I wonder...—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: You truly have the air of a sleeping deity whiling away the hours, Kris S. However...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“—O straying worker!
I shall bestow a mission upon you!”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In order to bestow the “Sweet Fruit of Corruption”
upon the beloved masses,
a mediator to allocate the budget is required.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: And that arbiter is none other than you, Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Serve the Conqueror King as the right hand
that supports my glorious conquest!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (What we need are the items for sale—ingredients for candied apples. Plus candied carrots, candied grapes... Cooking utensils for them. Wrapping paper, etc.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(As for the stall banners and signboards...
some say the provided paint isn't enough.
We'll order the shortage... and the counter inside is—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It is complete.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—well done, my faithful aide.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...? Facility layout plans, candidate material suppliers, and even a list of rental items...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, not just the budget?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
To—draw up a budget—we need to—identify our target goal,
and lay out—the procurement items.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Was it... unnecessary?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's amazing!
I'm super grateful~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd offer so many suggestions...!
Maybe I had the wrong idea about you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Truly a warrior of few words and decisive action—
Magnificent, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What a truly well-thought-out plan.
With this, the food stall should run without any hitches...
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Though the wise stay silent,
their minds harbor boundless contemplation.
Therefore, you are worthy to be my right hand!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us march forth together! Bathed in the breath of
thy 'Reason,' my dark 'Passion' shall manifest
a brand-new 'Temple of Delight'!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Ah—I will continue—to do my best.

—The day of the Holy Hoof Festival.
Hearing that Symboli Kris S's class was running a food stall,
I went over to take a look...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Welcome.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood.
—That will be... 500 yen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
It exceeds expectations.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Jeez, I've been on my feet the whole time~. It really takes it out of you, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――That is... a problem.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a problem!?
Did something bad happen...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Take this.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Huh? A chair...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... When you said 'problem' earlier...
Did you mean something like, 'getting tired from standing is a problem'?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Kris S-chan, you're so sweet~
Thanks, I'll take plenty of breaks while I work on it~

Though she is a girl of few words, her thoughtful and sincere
nature shines through... Catching a glimpse of that
filled me with a heartwarming feeling.

—The day of the Holy Hoof Festival.
Hearing that Symboli Kris S's class was running a food stall,
I went over to take a look...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Welcome.

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me, three candied apples please!
—One carrot candy, please!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Hyek, what a huge line...!
Since when...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—!
—Can't—catch a break, huh.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
...!! Non-stop labor...!
I-I guess there's no way around it...!!
choice_data_list: If we adjust the shifts, we can get a break, huh.
If we adjust the shifts, we can get a break, okay?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ah—I'll make adjustments quickly.
Please handle—things here.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Has the god of fate grown cross with us?
Kris S, take up your pen once more.
Rewrite our scenario to the end.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh... That's what you meant...
Alright, I'll do my best until break time then!

Symboli Kris S is a horse of few words, as always.
Even so, I silently hoped that her true intentions
would gradually reach those around her.

—The day of the Holy Hoof Festival.
Hearing that Symboli Kris S's class was running a food stall,
I went over to take a look...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"This is the Paradise Lost I sought—
A luscious, sparkling crimson... How beautiful..."
choice_data_list: (Kris S is... working behind the scenes, huh?)
(Kris S is... working behind the scenes.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Not enough.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, not enough!?
I see, it's because I didn't work hard enough...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—No, could it be about the apple stock?
The candy apples have been selling extraordinarily well, after all.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it now!
Kris S-san's words are always so profound...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Mortals are easily swayed by crimson temptation.
It's only natural for them to swarm around the 'sweet fruit of corruption'.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Added 10 more boxes.
――In the afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then, while we wait for Satan's instigation,
I shall dedicate myself to bestowing
the divine fruits of paradise!

...Somehow, our cooperation as classmates seemed to work out.
Feeling relieved, the candied apple I bit into
tasted wonderfully delicious.
